Title: In Development: Build an ASP.NET Application with MSAL

Body.Content:
As a C# developer, you can now:
- Register your web application in the Azure portal benefit from quick starts samples during application registration to help you get a working application in minutes
-Leverage a new ASP.NET Core template to create your application
-Azure AD v2 endpoint is on parity with v1 endpoing and developers can utilize the Azure AD v2.0 endpoint to develop apps

Learn more.
